# netbox_site_group (Data Source)

Retrieves a single site group from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Assumes the corresponding site groups exist
data "netbox_site_group" "get_by_name" {
  name = "example-sitegroup-1"
}

data "netbox_site_group" "get_by_slug" {
  slug = "sitegrp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the site group. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the site group. At least one of `name` or `slug` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the site group.
- `created` (String) When the site group was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the site group, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the site group.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the site group was last changed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the site group.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the site group.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix objects that refer to the site group.
- `site_count` (Number) The number of site objects that refer to the site group.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
